messages:
Rina: opened a compact PR that adds a 'auto-detect' recommendation for quant profile fallbacks when workloads mix short and medium sequences. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012
Alec: can you TL;DR the heuristic? I want a one-liner for the console quick-help.
Rina: one-liner: detect median input length; if <64 use qprofile-compact, if 64-512 prefer dynamic-8, otherwise dynamic-4. When variance high, prefer dynamic-8 fallback.
Harper: nice. We should show a short policy snippet for routing fallback on the platform: prefer compact, but if EM drops >1pp rollback to dynamic-8.
Rina: added a pseudo-policy block and a tiny eval command to compute EM delta.
Alec: can we include a minimal curl + JS SDK example that shows switching quant_profile on the fly? helps support teams.
Rina: added both. JS snippet:
```js
const rd = require('redwood')
const c = new rd.Client({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY})
await c.generate({model: 'redwood/opt-mini-1.0', inputs:['When was X born?'], quant_profile: 'qprofile-compact', batch_size: 4})
```
Harper: add the Python form too, and please keep hosted-safe defaults in examples.
Rina: Python added and hosted note: batch_size <= 8, kv_prefetch=true for shortseqs.
ci-bot: lint check passed for docs, 1 warning about a long table cell.
Marta: small UX ask: instead of a long quant table, add a condensed decision flow graphic or a bullets callout so new users don't scroll.
Rina: converted to a brief decision flow and linked the full table below.
docs-bot: Preview build succeeded  https://redwood-docs-pr-preview.netlify.app/pr/5012  4 files changed, 1 new script.
Alec: nit: the eval command uses `--metrics em,bleu` but we prefer `em,f1` for QA.
Rina: fixed metrics and added the infra command for QE: `./tools/eval_shortseq.py --model redwood/opt-mini-1.0 --quant qprofile-compact --corpus docs/examples/optimize/mixedseq-sample.json --metrics em,f1`
Harper: can we add a small note about i18n token length differences and recommend running the eval on language-specific subsets?
Rina: added an i18n caveat + sample filter command for corpora.
Alec: final: who reviews? Harper for content, Marta for UX. I'll do a quick pass after them.
Harper: LGTM for eval and heuristics.
Marta: small wording tweak in the callout  changed and LGTM.
Alec: merging after CI window. Thanks team :rocket:
Rina: merged and filed follow-up issue #1218 to track telemetry and auto-fallback experiment.
